english.note: Use 爆笑 when people suddenly burst into laughter, not when they erupt in anger.

examples.english: We couldn't help but erupt into laughter when we saw his funny expression.
examples.traditional: 睇到佢個滑稽樣，我哋成班人忍唔住爆笑。
